I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL backend to use `"database"` and `"password"` instead of the deprecated `"db"` and `"passwd"` keyword arguments:

- Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wyu65v6h/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L230) in [base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wyu65v6h/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to set `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['password']` from `settings_dict['NAME']` and `settings_dict['PASSWORD']`.
- Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wyu65v6h/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L59) in [client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-wyu65v6h/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to check `'database'` in `OPTIONS` before falling back to `'db'` and `settings_dict['NAME']`.
